result.instructions: Tools for Templated, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Make a 1080×1080 JPG from my 'Sale banner' template with the headline 'Summer sale 30% off'."; "List the layers of my invoice template so I know what to fill in."; "Show my remaining API credits and plan.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Templated data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run templated_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run templated_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run templated_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. templated_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: templated_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Show your Templated account: name, plan, and API credit usage against your quota. Good first call to check the key works. Templated API: GET /v1/account.

tools.name: templated_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List your templates with their id, name, size and layer count. Optionally include layers or pages. Templated API: GET /v1/templates.

externalId.description: Filter by your own external id.

includePages.description: Include each template's pages and layers (default false).

tools.name: templated_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template by id, optionally with its layers or pages. Templated API: GET /v1/template/{id}.

id.description: The Templated id (from the matching list or create tool).

includePages.description: Include the template's pages and layers (default false).

tools.name: templated_list_template_layers
tools.title: List template layers
tools.description: List the layers of one template: each layer name, type (text, image, shape, …) and group. Use the layer names as keys in templated_create_render. Templated API: GET /v1/template/{id}/layers.

id.description: The Templated id (from the matching list or create tool).

includeLockedLayers.description: Include layers locked in the editor (default false).

tools.name: templated_list_template_renders
tools.title: List renders of a template
tools.description: List the renders made from one template, newest first, with their file urls. Templated API: GET /v1/template/{id}/renders.

id.description: The Templated id (from the matching list or create tool).

externalId.description: Filter by your own external id.

tools.name: templated_get_render
tools.title: Get a render
tools.description: Get one render by id: its file url, size, format, template and creation time. Templated API: GET /v1/render/{id}.

id.description: The Templated id (from the matching list or create tool).

tools.name: templated_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List your template and render folders. Templated API: GET /v1/folders.

tools.name: templated_create_render
tools.title: Create a render
tools.description: Create an image, PDF, or video from a template with new layer values. Each call uses API credits and stores a new file. Returns the render with its file url. Templated API: POST /v1/render.

template.description: The template id to render (from templated_list_templates).

layers.description: Layer values keyed by layer name (from templated_list_template_layers). Each value holds properties such as {"text": "Hello"}, {"color": "#ff0000"} or {"image_url": "https://…"}.

format.description: Output format (default jpg). Transparency needs png; mp4 needs a video template.

width.description: Output width in pixels (default: the template's width).

height.description: Output height in pixels (default: the template's height).

scale.description: Scale factor applied to the output size.

name.description: A name for the render, shown in your dashboard.

tools.name: templated_delete_render
tools.title: Delete a render
tools.description: Permanently delete one render: its file, the data sent to create it, and its record. This cannot be undone. Templated API: DELETE /v1/render/{id}.

id.description: The Templated id (from the matching list or create tool).

tools.name: templated_clone_template
tools.title: Clone a template
tools.description: Copy one template into a new template with a new id. The copy keeps a link to the source. Templated API: POST /v1/template/{id}/clone.

id.description: The Templated id (from the matching list or create tool).

tools.name: templated_delete_template
tools.title: Delete a template
tools.description: Permanently delete one template by id. This is irreversible: a deleted template cannot be recovered. Check the id with templated_get_template first. Templated API: DELETE /v1/template/{id}.

id.description: The Templated id (from the matching list or create tool).
